metadata.summary: BioASQ is an annual large-scale community challenge on biomedical semantic question answering over the biomedical literature. It releases a growing corpus of biomedical semantic resources and a set of tasks: large-scale online MEDLINE indexing, document retrieval, passage retrieval, snippet extraction, semantic/reading-comprehension question answering, and a novel biomedical semantic QA task that combines retrieval and generation. Training/development data are drawn from PubMed abstracts and full-text biomedical articles in English.
metadata.purpose: To advance biomedical semantic question answering over the biomedical literature, emphasizing literature-based QA rather than clinical prediction.
metadata.avoided_uses: Clinical decision support or patient-level prediction; non-English biomedical QA.
creators: National Centre for Scientific Research "Demokritos" and collaborators

papers.title: BioASQ: A large biomedical semantic QA challenge

ethics.privacy_measures: Data consists of publicly available PubMed/PMC literature; no personal health information.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PubMed/PMC reuse policies; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 governs challenge data.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: tasks_and_use/intended_tasks[list-items]

known_limitations: QA is literature/retrieval-oriented rather than patient-level.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Biased toward English-language, PubMed-indexed, peer-reviewed biomedical literature; underrepresents non-English, grey, or clinical-source literature.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Results may not generalize to non-English biomedical QA, clinical EHR-based QA, or domains outside PubMed/PMC coverage.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No patient-level or clinical encounter data; no demographic or geographic metadata about article origins.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Clinical prediction, patient-level diagnosis, multimodal reasoning

data_origin.selection_rationale: Training/development data are drawn from PubMed abstracts and full-text biomedical articles in English.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Annual release of curated biomedical literature (PubMed/PMC) for QA tasks; corpus grows yearly.

population.target_population: Biomedical literature (PubMed abstracts and full-text articles in English)

annotation.annotation_method: Human experts construct questions and answers based on biomedical literature; some tasks involve NLP-assisted annotation (e.g., snippet extraction).

annotators.qualifications: Biomedical domain experts and NLP researchers

annotation.labeling_provenance: Questions and answers manually created by domain experts from PubMed/PMC content.
